newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Sept 12.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Sept 12.

text.p: -- Gillette Co is near a deal to acquire Duracell International Inc in a stock swap, according to sources familiar with the situation. The Wall Street Journal estimated the value of the transaction at over $7 billion, or $58.85 per Duracell share.
Gillette closed Wednesday at 65. Duracell closed at 48-3/8.
-- The pact for Xerox Corp to sell its Talegen insurance business to investors led by Kohlberg Kravis Roberts for $2.7 billion was terminated, the companies said.

-- The Federal Trade Commission voted 3-2 to approve a settlement that paves the way for completion of the $5.6 billion merger between Time Warner Inc and Turner Broadcasting System Inc, the Wall Street Journal said.
-- Fleming Cos Inc said it agreed to pay $20 million to settle two lawsuits pending against it in Miami.
